en: Hand‑colored postcard showing a forested river gorge with steep pine‑covered hillsides. Several small wooden and half‑timbered buildings with red and dark roofs stand along the left bank. A narrow path and a small bridge lead down to the water, where rowboats are moored. In the foreground, three people in early 20th‑century clothing sit in a rowing boat on the calm river. German text in red is printed in the top‑right and along the right edge.
